metaDescription: Plan a safer bike route in Bordeaux and Tournai with Sécu'Cycle: a route matched to your profile, your bike and the kind of road.
h1: Safer bike route planner for Bordeaux and Tournai
erreurGenerique: Something went wrong while planning your route.

badges.eclairageActif: It is dark out: street lighting is factored into this route.
badges.eclairageInactif: In daylight (or during the overnight switch-off), street lighting is not factored into the route.
badges.airDegrade: Regional air quality is poor: this route favours streets set back from traffic, where exposure to pollution is lowest.
badges.ventTitre: {{vitesse}} km/h wind. The duration estimate accounts for it, but the route itself was not changed.
badges.pontsTitre: A bridge deck loses heat from both sides and freezes one to two hours before the road on either side of it.

securite.cyclableFort: More than half the route ({{pct}}%) runs on dedicated cycle tracks or lanes, separated from motor traffic.
securite.cyclableMoyen: {{pct}}% of the route uses cycling infrastructure (track, lane or greenway), limiting interactions with cars.
securite.cyclableFaible: The route favours residential streets and calmed roads to keep motor traffic to a minimum.
securite.lentFort: {{pct}}% of the route is in a 30 km/h zone, which markedly lowers both the risk and the severity of a crash.
securite.lentMoyen: {{pct}}% of the route runs through reduced-speed zones (30 km/h or less).
securite.eclaire: {{pct}}% of the route is lit, giving good visibility after dark.
securite.sansAccident: No cycling crash has been officially recorded along this route.
securite.accidents_one: {{count}} cycling crash has been recorded along this route; those segments carry a lowered safety score.
securite.accidents_other: {{count}} cycling crashes have been recorded along this route; those segments carry a lowered safety score.
securite.varianteSafe: The algorithm picked this route as the safest of the options it computed, favouring the safety score over speed.
securite.varianteCompromise: This route balances safety against duration: it stays within the time you allowed while maximising the distance spent on safer roads.
securite.ponts_one: It is {{temperature}} °C and this route crosses {{count}} bridge: a deck loses heat from both sides and can be icy while the road beside it is not.
securite.ponts_other: It is {{temperature}} °C and this route crosses {{count}} bridges: a deck loses heat from both sides and can be icy while the road beside it is not.
securite.alerte: {{libelle}} {{quand}} over the departure area. This did not change the route: at this resolution (~28 km), the forecast warns you without steering the route away.
